title: Tournament format
description: The shape of a format file. Rules that compare values (pool size, number of games, known templates and towns) are checked in the code, not here.

id.description: Lowercase words joined by dashes, for example sample-cup. Must match the file name.

name.description: The name players see, for example Sample Cup.

description.description: What the tournament is, shown by /info. At most 1000 characters.

additional_rules.description: Additional rules of the tournament as a whole, shown by /info. At most 1000 characters. Rules for one template go in its settings.

status.description: Archived formats stay in the repository but cannot start new matches. Default: active.

thread_visibility.description: Who can read the match thread. Default: public.

roll_rules.description: Roll rules for every template of the tournament. Leave out what you do not change: the defaults apply.

settings.description: The timer, and the recommended simultaneous turns, for every template of the tournament. Roads, map size and computer players can only be chosen for a template.

allowed_towns.description: Towns players can get in every phase, unless a phase states its own list. Leave it out to allow every town.

templates.description: Every template used in the tournament, each once. Write a plain id, or an object to give the template settings of its own in all phases.

phases.description: One or more phases, for example group stage and knockout.

townList.description: Town ids from data/towns.json. At least two, because the bot draws a pair of different towns from them.

roll_cost.description: Gold paid to roll the town pair, in whole hundreds (gold moves in steps of 100). Default: 500.

rolls_per_player.description: Rolls each player may use. Default: 1.

max_roll_bans.description: Towns a player may ban when rolling. Default: 2.

timer.description: The chess timer of every game, written like 12:00+06:00+02:00: the time each player has at the start, the time added at the beginning of each of their turns, and the time added when each fight starts. Always mm:ss, two digits everywhere, seconds below 60.

sim_turns.description: How long simultaneous turns are recommended to last: the last day, as month, week and day in digits, for example 117 (month 1, week 1, day 7). Replaces what the template recommends.

roads.description: Roads, map size and computer players can only be chosen for a template (in the tournament's list of templates or in a phase's pool), not for the whole tournament.

map_size.description: Roads, map size and computer players can only be chosen for a template (in the tournament's list of templates or in a phase's pool), not for the whole tournament.

ai.description: Roads, map size and computer players can only be chosen for a template (in the tournament's list of templates or in a phase's pool), not for the whole tournament.

download.description: A download link can only be given for a template (in the tournament's list of templates or in a phase's pool).

additional_rules.description: Rules for the whole tournament are written as "additional_rules" next to "name", not in "settings". In "settings" they are for one template.

timer.description: The chess timer for this template, like 12:00+06:00+02:00. Replaces the tournament's timer.

sim_turns.description: The recommended last day of simultaneous turns for this template, like 117. Replaces what the template recommends.

roads.description: The roads for this template: none, or slow, mid and fast joined by + in that order (for example mid or slow+mid). Must be one of the values the template allows.

map_size.description: The map size for this template: S, M, L, XL, H, XH or G, with +U for underground (for example L+U). Must be one of the sizes the template allows.

ai.description: The number of computer players for this template, 0 to 6. Must be one of the numbers the template allows.

additional_rules.description: Additional rules for this template, at most 1000 characters. Replace the rules the template states.

download.description: A link starting with https:// where the version of the template this tournament plays can be downloaded. Use it when it is not the version built into HotA.

templateEntry.description: A template id from data/templates.json, or an object with the id and settings for this template. Settings written here win over the ones written for the whole tournament, field by field.

best_of.description: Games in the match. 2 is for league formats where both games are always played.

pool.description: The templates of the tournament that this phase uses. An object entry gives a template settings for this phase only. Leave the pool out to use all the templates of the tournament.

type.description: sequence: bans and picks in a fixed order. agreed: the players agree on the template.

steps.description: What happens, in order. The games are played in the order of the picks, then the decider.

who.description: Who acts: A is the coinflip winner, B the other player. Not used by the decider.

do.description: ban or pick by the player in 'who'. decider: the template that is left becomes the last game. It has no 'who' and must be the last step.

allowed_towns.description: Towns players can get in this phase. This list replaces the tournament's list. Leave it out to use the tournament's.
